sloka: ततस्तत् पुष्पकं दिव्यं सुग्रीवः सह सेनया ।अध्यारोहत्त्वरन् शीघ्रं सामात्यश्च विभीषणः ।। ६.१२५.२६ ।।
transliteration: tatastat puṣpakaṁ divyaṁ sugrīvaḥ saha senayā ।adhyārohattvaran śīghraṁ sāmātyaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.125.26 ।।

translations.english: Delighted and thrilled, Rama was flying in the sky in Pushpaka and with shining swans, he shone like Kubera.
